faq: Does the checker see my account number?
No. You type only the IFSC code. The code is checked in your browser; nothing about your business is sent anywhere.
Can it tell me whether an account number is right?
No. Only the bank can. When you pay by NEFT or RTGS, your bank shows the account holder's name before you confirm: read it every time.
How current is the list?
The date of the data is shown under every result. A branch opened after that date may be missing.

Does the PIN code finder show advertisements?
No. Inside the App there are none.

Does the distance calculator show advertisements?

Parties, items and units are shared by every business on this device, as in My data. Voucher types (number series) and banks are kept per business.
Is this the same as My data?
Yes, the same records: My data on my.niveshsahayak.in shows them too, with import and export to Excel.

Where do I see who cancelled it and why?
My data › Edit history: every cancel and undo is there with the reason and the time.

faq: Does NSBiz file my return?
No. It prepares the form, the JSON and the filled Excel tool. You upload and file on the GST portal with your own login.
Do I need internet to fill a tool?
Only the first time, to download the tool from gst.gov.in. After that NSBiz uses the copy it keeps on this device.
What happens when the department releases a new version?
Download it from gst.gov.in and press Change template file beside the button. The new one is kept from then on.

faq: Is the original tool changed?
No. Excel fills a copy and saves it under a new name; the downloaded tool is kept as it is for next time.
Why is a row missing from ITC-01?
ITC-01 lists invoices only. Goods made here, opening stock and capital goods are left out of that tool.

faq: Can I delete a GST TDS entry?
Yes, with Delete on its row in the table.
Where are the filled files?
In Downloads, named with your GSTIN, GSTR7 or GSTR6, and the month. With auto save to a folder on, also in NSBiz › GST Returns.

faq: Does every sale need TCS now?
No. Only the sales the TCS box lists (section 394). Other goods have no TCS; the old ₹50 lakh rule is gone.
Where is the Form 127 noted?
On the bill (the printed line), and in the Form 143 Excel as a row with remark B and no tax.
